result.citation: Santa Ana Mun. Code ch. 8, art. XIX, § 8-3120(a) (Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance; Ord. No. NS-3027, as amended by Ord. No. NS-3052 and as amended through Ord. No. NS-3073); see also id. § 8-3120(b), (c), (d)
result.citation_basis: ch. 8, art. XIX, § 8-3120(a), Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance (§ 8-3100 title), Ord. Nos. NS-3027, NS-3052, NS-3073: O098; § 8-3120(b), (c), (d): O063
result.official_quote: After a Tenant has continuously and lawfully occupied a Residential Real Property for thirty (30) days, the Owner of the Residential Real Property shall not terminate the Tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in the written notice to terminate Tenancy.
result.condition: You are protected only after you have lived in the unit continuously and lawfully for 30 days.
result.condition_quote: After a Tenant has continuously and lawfully occupied a Residential Real Property for thirty (30) days
